howto.what_en: Claude scaffolds FastAPI projects from templates: it generates the app layout (api, core, models, schemas, services, repositories), async route handlers, Depends-based dependency injection, middleware, error handling, and pytest/httpx async tests.
howto.when_en: Use when starting a new FastAPI application or setting up a backend API project, including async REST APIs with PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
